theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_id_restrict_sigmaFinite
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μ) → SigmaFinite (μ.restrict M)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
